title: NPC memory: Marta the smith is cold because the player insulted her wares earlier

Marta.description: Broad-shouldered blacksmith with forearms like anchor chains
Marta.personality_traits: Proud of her craft; holds a grudge; fair to those who earn it

history.content: Aria: Your swords are overpriced garbage, smith.

{"actions": [{"type": "speak", "npc_name": "Marta", "text": "Garbage is it? The door's that way. It closes on its own, free of charge."}, {"type": "narrate", "text": "She turns back to the forge, and the bellows answer for her — a hard, dismissive blast of heat."}]}

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I come back the next morning and ask Marta to sharpen my blade.

actions.text: Sharpen it? Aye. Double rate, after yesterday. The steel forgives faster than I do.
She holds out a calloused palm for the coin first, and doesn't look at you while she waits.
